name: Quibi
what_failed: Short-form streaming platform that raised $1.75B and shut down in 6 months.
why_it_failed: Launched during pandemic (commuting use case eliminated)
No social sharing (couldn't screenshot or clip)
Content didn't differentiate from existing platforms
Misread the constraint: attention, not content length
Hollywood production model vs creator economy
assumptions_that_broke: A new platform can compete with free
Content length is the binding constraint
Hollywood production values win in short-form
constraints_that_moved: Attention became the scarce resource, not content
resurrection_conditions: Integrated with social platforms rather than competing
lesson: When the binding constraint is attention and distribution, not content quality, a content-first strategy fails. Understand which constraint actually binds.
